project: VARDHANI HIGH-SPECIALIST R3 — GPT-5.6 SOL TEACHER / STUDENT-250 V2
purpose: Test a structurally distinct causal source of intraday edge: failed attempts to extend the current-session high or low, followed by observable cross-market rejection and short-horizon mean reversion. This is not an inversion of failed R3M trades and does not reuse R3M's compression-breakout logic.

predecessor_evidence.R3M: Compression-breakout continuation failed 2023 with net3 -2.3555bps and net5 -4.3555bps; 2024 remained unopened.
predecessor_evidence.earlier_rejection_evidence: R3L's small preregistered REJECT specialist was positive at net3 but too sparse and did not clear net5, suggesting failed-break behaviour deserves a dedicated independent test rather than being mixed with continuation.
predecessor_evidence.design_inference: Directly identify a causal session-extreme breach that closes back inside the prior session range, then require current NIFTY/SENSEX reversal agreement and inverse VIX response before entry.
not_permitted: automatic inversion of predecessor losing trades

signal.adaptive_history: previous 126 completed trading-date observations at the same clock checkpoint only
signal.prior_session_extreme_definition: prior_session_high_t = running session high through t-1; prior_session_low_t = running session low through t-1; current minute t is excluded from those references
failed_high_conditions: current NIFTY high strictly exceeds prior_session_high_t
current NIFTY close is strictly below prior_session_high_t
current NIFTY candle body is negative
current NIFTY causal 5-minute return is negative
India VIX causal 5-minute return is positive
failed_low_conditions: current NIFTY low strictly breaks prior_session_low_t
current NIFTY close is strictly above prior_session_low_t
current NIFTY candle body is positive
current NIFTY causal 5-minute return is positive
India VIX causal 5-minute return is negative
signal.same_timestamp_conflict: if both failed-high and failed-low conditions are true at one timestamp, emit WAIT

horizon_router.reversal_strength: absolute NIFTY causal 5-minute return at signal
horizon_router.strength_threshold: previous-126 same-checkpoint median of absolute NIFTY 5-minute return
horizon_router.entry: next genuine same-session minute open after signal

qualification.if_2023_passes: freeze R3N configuration and then and only then open 2024 audit
qualification.if_2023_fails: retire R3N without opening 2024; preregister a structurally distinct R3O before any R3O output

option_gate.data: genuine 2024 full-chain NIFTY option candles from authorized Sep-Oct expiry weeks
